[LCCO.10.3] At chain depth two, the inner call's continuations
may reference outer LHS bindings, and each reads as the outer capture fact held
it when the outer continuation fired ([LCCO.5.4]). The compiler **must** carry
those values into the inner call's capture fact ([LCCO.5.2]), which the
continuation that makes the inner call asserts, so the inner continuations join
that one capture fact on the inner correlation.
